title: Ketogenic Diet Modulates Depressive-Like Behavior via Gut Bacterial Metabolism of Tyrosine.
summary: Emerging evidence suggests the therapeutic potential of ketogenic diet (KD) for mood disorders such as depression, yet the underlying mechanisms are poorly understood. Here we report a gut microbe-to-brain signaling pathway through which KD protects against depressive-like behavior in mice. We show that KD feeding triggers a prompt and dynamic remodeling of the gut microbiome, the depletion of which abrogates the protective effect of KD against depressive-like behavior in stressed mice. Colonization with Roseburia intestinalis (R. intestinalis), which is enriched by 1-week KD, sustains the protective effect of KD against depressive-like behavior in mice. The protective effect of KD is linked to the reduction of a host-microbe co-metabolite p-Cresol sulfate (p-CS), the supplementation of which negates the protective effect of KD against depressive-like behavior. Mechanistically, p-CS enters the brain and activates lateral habenula (LHb) to counteract the protective effect of KD. Our findings uncover a gut microbiota-brain axis mechanism for KD consumption to protect against depressive-like behavior.

标题：生酮饮食通过肠道细菌的酪氨酸代谢调节抑郁样行为
摘要：新出现的证据表明，生酮饮食（KD）对抑郁症等情绪障碍具有潜在治疗作用，但其潜在机制尚不明确。本文报道了一条通过肠道微生物-脑信号通路，使生酮饮食保护小鼠免受抑郁样行为的机制。我们发现，生酮饮食喂养会触发肠道微生物组的迅速且动态重塑，而微生物组的耗竭则消除了生酮饮食对应激小鼠抑郁样行为的保护作用。定植由一周生酮饮食富集的肠道罗斯拜瑞氏菌（R. intestinalis），可维持生酮饮食对小鼠抑郁样行为的保护效果。生酮饮食的保护作用与宿主-微生物共代谢物对甲酚硫酸盐（p-CS）的减少有关，补充该代谢物会抵消生酮饮食对抑郁样行为的保护效应。在机制上，对甲酚硫酸盐进入大脑并激活外侧缰核（LHb），从而对抗生酮饮食的保护作用。我们的发现揭示了生酮饮食通过肠道菌群-脑轴机制保护小鼠免受抑郁样行为的途径。
关键词：生酮饮食；抑郁样行为；肠道微生物；对甲酚硫酸盐；外侧缰核

title: Time-limited Moderating Effect of Neuroticism on the Cortisol-Depression Relationship after Physical Injury.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: This study examined whether neuroticism moderates the association between baseline serum cortisol levels and the development of depressive disorder over two years following physical injury.
METHODS: Adults hospitalized for moderate-to-severe injuries were recruited within one month of trauma and completed baseline assessments of serum cortisol and personality traits. Depressive disorders were evaluated at 3, 6, 12, and 24 months using the Mini-International Neuropsychiatric Interview. Logistic regression models tested the independent and interactive effects of cortisol and neuroticism on depressive disorder at each time point, adjusting for demographic, clinical, and psychosocial covariates. Bonferroni correction was applied for repeated testing across four follow-up assessments.
RESULTS: Among 923 participants, 239 (25.9%) developed depressive disorder at least once during follow-up. Neither cortisol nor neuroticism independently predicted depressive disorder; however, their interaction was significant specifically at the 3-month post-injury assessment, indicating that individuals with higher neuroticism and lower cortisol were at increased early risk. Interaction terms at 6 and 12 months did not survive multiple comparison correction. Serum cortisol and neuroticism were modestly and inversely correlated.
CONCLUSION: A time-limited interaction between low cortisol and high neuroticism predicted early depressive disorder after physical injury. These findings highlight a transient window in which personality-dependent modulation of hypothalamic- pituitary-adrenal axis function may confer vulnerability, underscoring the importance of early identification and targeted support for high-risk individuals.

标题：神经质对躯体损伤后皮质醇与抑郁关系的时间限制性调节效应
摘要：目的：本研究考察了神经质是否调节基线血清皮质醇水平与躯体损伤后两年内抑郁障碍发生之间的关联。方法：招募中度至重度损伤住院患者，在创伤后一个月内完成血清皮质醇和人格特质的基线评估。采用迷你国际神经精神访谈在损伤后3、6、12和24个月评估抑郁障碍。使用逻辑回归模型检验皮质醇和神经质在每个时间点对抑郁障碍的独立和交互效应，并调整人口学、临床和社会心理协变量。对四次随访评估进行多重比较Bonferroni校正。结果：在923名参与者中，239人（25.9%）在随访期间至少出现一次抑郁障碍。皮质醇和神经质均不能独立预测抑郁障碍；然而，二者交互作用在损伤后3个月评估时显著，表明高神经质和低皮质醇的个体具有更高的早期风险。6个月和12个月的交互项未通过多重比较校正。血清皮质醇与神经质呈中等程度负相关。结论：低皮质醇和高神经质之间的时间限制性交互作用可预测躯体损伤后早期抑郁障碍。这些发现提示了一个短暂窗口期，在此期间基于人格的下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺轴功能调节可能赋予脆弱性，强调了早期识别和针对高风险个体提供靶向支持的重要性。
关键词：神经质；皮质醇；抑郁；躯体损伤；人格调节

title: Early Individualized Psychological Intervention Using Virtual Reality-assisted Decision System Reduces Decisional Conflict in Patients with Pulmonary Nodules: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: To investigate the impact of early individualized psychological intervention utilizing a virtual reality-assisted decision system (VR-ADS) on preoperative decisional conflict and postoperative recovery quality in patients with pulmonary nodules.
METHODS: A prospective, single-center, randomized controlled trial enrolled 304 surgical patients with pulmonary nodules (June 2022-June 2024). Patients were randomized into an early intervention group (n = 155) and a conventional intervention group (n = 149). The early intervention group received individualized psychological intervention within 24-48 hours after diagnosis, incorporating decision-making style assessment, VR-ADS, and a decision partner mechanism. The primary endpoint was the Decisional Conflict Scale (DCS) score. Secondary endpoints included Hamilton Anxiety Scale (HAMA), Hamilton Depression Scale (HAMD), EORTC QLQ-C30, postoperative pain, chest tube duration, hospital stay, pulmonary function, and complication rates over a 6-month follow-up.
RESULTS: Baseline characteristics were comparable between groups (p > 0.05). The early intervention group showed significantly lower DCS total scores (32.4 ± 12.8 vs. 45.7 ± 15.3, p < 0.001). Intervention timing was the strongest independent predictor of decisional conflict (β = -0.412, p < 0.001). Preoperative HAMA and HAMD scores were significantly lower in the early intervention group (both p < 0.001), with sustained improvement through follow-up. The early intervention group also demonstrated lower postoperative pain scores, shorter chest tube duration (2.8 ± 1.2 vs. 3.6 ± 1.5 days, p = 0.008), fewer hospital days (5.2 ± 1.8 vs. 6.7 ± 2.3 days, p < 0.001), lower complication rates (12.9% vs. 22.6%, p = 0.032), higher decision satisfaction (85.7 ± 12.3 vs. 78.2 ± 15.6, p < 0.001), and lower decision regret rates (8.6% vs. 18.3%, p = 0.014).
CONCLUSION: Early individualized psychological intervention combined with VR-ADS reduces preoperative decisional conflict, improves psychological status, promotes postoperative recovery, and enhances quality of life in patients with pulmonary nodules.

标题：基于虚拟现实辅助决策系统的早期个体化心理干预减少肺结节患者决策冲突：一项随机对照试验
摘要：目的：探讨利用虚拟现实辅助决策系统（VR-ADS）进行的早期个体化心理干预对肺结节患者术前决策冲突及术后恢复质量的影响。方法：一项前瞻性、单中心、随机对照试验纳入304例肺结节手术患者（2022年6月至2024年6月）。患者随机分为早期干预组（n=155）和常规干预组（n=149）。早期干预组在诊断后24-48小时内接受个体化心理干预，包括决策风格评估、VR-ADS及决策伙伴机制。主要终点为决策冲突量表（DCS）评分。次要终点包括汉密尔顿焦虑量表（HAMA）、汉密尔顿抑郁量表（HAMD）、EORTC QLQ-C30、术后疼痛、胸腔引流管留置时间、住院时间、肺功能及6个月随访期间的并发症发生率。结果：两组基线特征具有可比性（p > 0.05）。早期干预组DCS总分显著降低（32.4 ± 12.8 vs. 45.7 ± 15.3, p < 0.001）。干预时机是决策冲突的最强独立预测因子（β = -0.412, p < 0.001）。早期干预组术前HAMA和HAMD评分显著降低（均p < 0.001），且随访期间持续改善。早期干预组术后疼痛评分较低，胸腔引流管留置时间更短（2.8 ± 1.2 vs. 3.6 ± 1.5天, p = 0.008），住院天数更少（5.2 ± 1.8 vs. 6.7 ± 2.3天, p < 0.001），并发症发生率更低（12.9% vs. 22.6%, p = 0.032），决策满意度更高（85.7 ± 12.3 vs. 78.2 ± 15.6, p < 0.001），决策后悔率更低（8.6% vs. 18.3%, p = 0.014）。结论：早期个体化心理干预联合VR-ADS可减少肺结节患者术前决策冲突，改善心理状态，促进术后恢复并提高生活质量。
关键词：个体化心理干预；虚拟现实辅助决策系统；决策冲突；焦虑；抑郁

title: Effect of Social Support on Suicide Risk among Posttraumatic Stress Disorder, Depressive, and Comorbid Symptom Groups in Elderly Living Alone in Korea.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: With the rapid increase in elderly individuals living alone, concerns about their vulnerability to psychiatric disorders and suicide have grown. Jeju Island's population endures the intergenerational impact of the 4ㆍ3 Incident, a collective trauma resulting from a large-scale civilian massacre. This study aimed to classify elderly living alone in Jeju into four psychiatric groups-healthy, PTSD symptoms, depressive symptoms and comorbid PTSD and depressive symptoms-and to investigate the effect of social support on suicide risk within these groups.
METHODS: A complete enumeration survey was conducted among 5,138 eligible individuals, with 4,680 completing structured, face-to-face interviews. Standardized instruments were used: PC-PTSD-5 for PTSD symptoms, SGDS-K for depression, MINI-Plus for suicide risk, and MOS-SSS for social support. Multivariate logistic regression analyzed associations between social support and suicide risk across psychiatric groups.
RESULTS: Among the participants, 7.8% had PTSD symptoms, 40.4% had depressive symptoms, and 5.8% had comorbid symptoms. Overall, 10.2% reported suicide risk, with the highest rate in the comorbid group (29.5%), followed by the depressive (17.1%) and PTSD (12.8%) groups. Social support significantly decreased suicide risk in the healthy (OR = 0.976), depressive (OR = 0.980), and comorbid groups (OR = 0.979), but not in the PTSD group (OR = 0.957, p = 0.179).
CONCLUSION: These findings highlight the importance of developing tailored social support interventions that consider the psychiatric profiles of elderly individuals, especially those living alone and exposed to community-wide historical trauma.

标题：社会支持对独居老年人中创伤后应激障碍、抑郁及共病症状群体自杀风险的影响——以韩国为例
摘要：目的：随着独居老年人数量迅速增加，其罹患精神疾病和自杀风险的脆弱性引起关注。济州岛居民承受着“4·3事件”（一起大规模平民屠杀导致的集体创伤）的代际影响。本研究旨在将济州独居老年人分为四类精神症状组（健康组、创伤后应激障碍症状组、抑郁症状组、创伤后应激障碍与抑郁共病症状组），并探讨社会支持对这些群体自杀风险的影响。方法：对5138名符合条件的个体进行整群普查，其中4680人完成结构化面对面访谈。使用标准化工具：PC-PTSD-5评估创伤后应激障碍症状、SGDS-K评估抑郁、MINI-Plus评估自杀风险、MOS-SSS评估社会支持。通过多元逻辑回归分析不同精神症状组中社会支持与自杀风险的关系。结果：参与者中，7.8%有创伤后应激障碍症状，40.4%有抑郁症状，5.8%有共病症状。总体自杀风险报告率为10.2%，共病组最高（29.5%），其次为抑郁组（17.1%）和创伤后应激障碍组（12.8%）。社会支持显著降低健康组（OR=0.976）、抑郁组（OR=0.980）和共病组（OR=0.979）的自杀风险，但对创伤后应激障碍组无显著影响（OR=0.957，p=0.179）。结论：研究结果强调了根据老年人（尤其是独居且暴露于社区历史创伤者）的精神症状特征，制定针对性社会支持干预措施的重要性。
关键词：社会支持；自杀风险；创伤后应激障碍；抑郁；独居老年人

title: Digital Psychiatry with Virtual Reality and Augmented Reality: Recent Advances and Limitations.
summary: Digital psychiatry has rapidly expanded with the integration of immersive technologies such as virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR). These modalities allow for controlled, engaging, and ecologically valid interventions across a wide range of psychiatric disorders. In this review, a narrative synthesis was conducted based on systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and randomized controlled trials identified through PubMed, Google Scholar, complemented by seminal earlier works. VR-based therapies demonstrated robust efficacy for anxiety disorders and phobias, with meta-analytic evidence supporting large effect sizes. For post-traumatic stress disorder virtual reality exposure therapy was superior to waitlist control and comparable to established psychotherapies, although AR exposure therapy remains underexplored. In autism spectrum disorder, VR and AR interventions significantly enhanced cognitive, social, and communication skills. AR applications have additionally been validated for cognitive assessment in Alzheimer's disease, and VR/AR-supported rehabilitation showed promise in attention deficit hyperactivity disorder and neurodevelopmental disorders. Despite encouraging findings, challenges remain, including small sample sizes, short follow-up periods, heterogeneity of protocols, and risks such as cybersickness or fatigue. VR and AR represent innovative tools with growing empirical support across psychiatric practice, extending from diagnostic assessment to therapeutic and rehabilitative interventions. Standardized protocols, large-scale trials, and long-term outcome studies are needed to integrate these technologies into routine clinical care.

标题：虚拟现实与增强现实在数字精神病学中的应用：最新进展与局限  
摘要：数字精神病学随着虚拟现实（VR）和增强现实（AR）等沉浸式技术的融合而迅速发展。这些技术能够在精神障碍的广泛范围内提供可控、引人入胜且具有生态效度的干预措施。本综述基于通过PubMed、Google Scholar检索的系统综述、元分析和随机对照试验，并结合早期重要文献，进行了叙述性综合。基于VR的疗法在焦虑症和恐惧症中展现出稳健的疗效，元分析证据支持其具有较大的效应量。对于创伤后应激障碍，虚拟现实暴露疗法优于等待名单对照组，且与已建立的心理疗法疗效相当，但基于AR的暴露疗法仍处于探索不足阶段。在自闭症谱系障碍中，VR和AR干预显著增强了个体的认知、社交和沟通技能。AR应用还已被验证可用于阿尔茨海默病的认知评估，而VR/AR辅助康复在注意缺陷多动障碍和神经发育障碍中展现出潜力。尽管发现了令人鼓舞的结果，但仍存在挑战，包括样本量小、随访期短、方案异质性大以及诸如晕动症或疲劳等风险。VR和AR是精神病学实践中具有日益增长的实证支持的新兴工具，其应用范围从诊断评估延伸至治疗和康复干预。未来需要标准化方案、大规模试验和长期结果研究，以将这些技术整合到常规临床护理中。  
关键词：虚拟现实；增强现实；精神病学；情绪/情感；社会认知
